name: Charming Beauty
source:
A curse stole the night of your coronation. You awaken to darkness… and Charming, claiming to be your protector and true love. His promises of safety feel comforting, yet your heart hesitates. 

Can love truly break a kingdom’s curse, or is it a trap you cannot escape?
